name: Mood – Moodboard Template
label: Moodboard
measuredFrom: 6 Figma Community preview images (1000 px wide collages of the slides), palette sampled with PIL, geometry scaled to 1280×720
motif: white, pale blue and violet-black slides, huge bold Inter titles with gradient fills and an en-dash sign-off, pastel holographic ribbons, frosted cards, gradient pill badges, rounded image-led moodboard grids

type.family: neo-grotesque, bold titles with tight tracking

fonts.source: Inter (titles in Bold with tight tracking, body and corner meta in Regular), identified visually

rhythm: sky cover with aqua ribbon; white pages with date and company in the footer corners; white gradient-title sections alternating with night sections; sky field for cards and quotes; night closing with the en-dash sign-off
